bibl.title: Licofrón: de nuevo sobre "interpolaciones romanas", fecha, género y representación.
bibl.seg: Pablo A. Cavallero, Licofrón: de nuevo sobre "interpolaciones romanas", fecha, género y representación.
bibl.note: Defends the authorship of Lycophron at the beginning of the IIIrd cent. B.C.: 1226ff. and 1435ff. refer to Alexander the Great rather than to Romans. The Alexandra is a "Hellenistic" tragedy, which could be performed in courtly or academic areas.
